verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's docs show the core loop. Campaigns can be composed with an email designer, custom-coded templates or AI-assisted creation (docs-14, docs-37, docs-42). Audiences and segments can be targeted (docs-4, docs-10, docs-44). The Marketing API can send a campaign immediately, and RSS campaigns send on a schedule (docs-5). Community reports of a text-editor outage and a builder module bug (comm-16, comm-17) are isolated incidents, not a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduling for regular (non-RSS) campaigns, an end-to-end walkthrough of picking an audience for a campaign, and independent hands-on confirmation of the full compose→audience→send/schedule flow.
